# VEKYA

> VEKYA is a solution studio for growing companies. Brand, Go-to-Market and AI, from first idea to lasting growth. VEKYA Inc. is a Canadian corporation operating since 2009, led by Mark Vecchiarelli.

## What VEKYA does

- Brand Strategy: positioning, naming, messaging and identity for companies that want to grow.
- Zero-to-One Builds: go-to-market, marketing and customer experience, stood up from a blank page.
- AI in Teams: practical, human-led ways to put AI to work across marketing, revenue and customer teams.
- Audits and Resets: a clear read on marketing, go-to-market and customer experience, and what to change next.
- Ventures: brands and products built from scratch and run under VEKYA Inc.
